He was the senior vice president and deputy provost of research at The Ohio State University and the senior vice president for research and innovation at the University of Missouri before arriving at Drexel in 2018. Jackiewicz has over 25 years of experience in academic administration. Prior to joining Drexel University, he served in a variety of leadership roles at The Ohio State University from 2011 to 2018.
